about: What make lint runs xplint on. Each target is a repository at a pinned commit, optionally changed by a patch or by exact text edits, linted with a pinned Go toolchain image. linter/expectations.json pins every finding of every target, with its triage; a run must match it exactly. 'history' targets are the commits before and after upstream fixes of the mistakes the rules describe; 'mutant' targets put a fixed bug back into wallet-backend main, and must make the named rule fire.

targets.name: stellar-etl@master
targets.note: master on 2026-11-17. Type-checked with Go 1.27.3, the version its go.mod names: Go 1.27.4 refuses the LLVM bitcode section in go-stellar-xdr-json's prebuilt arm64 libxdrjson.a (cmd/go security.go), and xplint only type-checks; nothing is linked or run
